'''Chiraneau''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] and an expert in the field of [[Realspace/Legends|deep-space]] transmissions, he was promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]] by [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Chiraneau was serving as Piett's personal [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] plummeted into the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star's]] surface.

==Biography==
===Ace pilot===
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="SWG" /> Chiraneau was an expert in the field of [[Realspace/Legends|deep-space]] transmissions. In his service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he also flew as a [[TIE pilot]], becoming an [[Ace/Legends|ace]].<ref name="CCG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Chiraneau partook in a skirmish against at least one [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]]. Although defeated in the engagement, Chiraneau managed to escape the battle in his crippled [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

Chiraneau was later promoted<ref name="CCG" /> to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]]<ref name="Miniatures">{{FFGXW|set=VT-49 Decimator Expansion Pack|cardname=Rear Admiral Chiraneau}}</ref> at the request of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]],<ref name="CCG" /> the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], the personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]<ref name="Piett db">{{DB|character|admiralpiett|Piett, Admiral}}</ref> of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Chiraneau served as Piett's personal [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]<ref name="CCG" /> aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|123|Chiraneau, Admiral}}</ref> the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the fleet.<ref name="ssd-db">{{DB|starship|superstardestroyer|Super Star Destroyer}}</ref> At some point during his service as a Rear Admiral, Chiraneau piloted a [[VT-49 Decimator/Legends|VT-49 Decimator]].<ref name="Miniatures" />

===Battle of Endor===
[[File:ChiraneausHugoBossJodhpurs-RotJ.png|thumb|left|180px|Chiraneau was present for Darth Vader's arrival aboard the second Death Star.]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Chiraneau was present aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] during its construction in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. He was one of the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] assembled to greet Vader when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] arrived aboard the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to discuss the station's lagging construction schedule with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]], the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> At some point around the same [[Time/Legends|time]] period, Chiraneau was among the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who strode down a corridor alongside Vader and Jerjerrod.<ref name="Imperial Command">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Imperial Command}}</ref>

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] launched an [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] on the Death Star,<ref name="ROTJ" /> Chiraneau served aboard the ''Executor'' as Piett's personal advisor during the engagement.<ref name="CSWE" /> After a Rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing starfighter]] crashed into the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], setting off a chain reaction that sent the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] out of control,<ref name="ROTJ" /> Chiraneau [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="CSWE" /> when the massive [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] collided with the Death Star's surface.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Chiraneau had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="CCG" /> brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="SWG" /> and light skin.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Skills and abilities==
Chiraneau was a deep-space transmissions expert<ref name="CCG" /> and a TIE fighter ace.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Equipment==
On one occasion, Admiral Chiraneau wore the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]] without a [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia plaque]] or a [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]],<ref name="SWG" /> though by 4 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> he wore the uniform with both of those.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Chiraneau.png|thumb|right|180px|Chiraneau, as he appeared in ''Star Wars Galaxies'']]
Admiral Chiraneau first appeared in the opening scene of [[1983]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] as an unnamed background character.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Although not credited in the film, he was portrayed by [[Mike Havord]].<ref name="EastBristol">{{WebCite|url=https://bid.eastbristol.co.uk/past-auctions/sreas10560/lot-details/8657729d-8fb5-4d99-b26a-ae2a01070019|text=Star Wars - Imperial Officers - Autograph Collection|work=[https://eastbristol.co.uk/ East Bristol Auctions]|archivedate=20240814145604}}</ref> He was given a name and a brief backstory in the [[2000]] ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]],<ref name="CCG" /> and in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' Chiraneau's name appeared as one of the leaders for an AI player controlling the Empire in the standard game mode.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

Chiraneau, in his TIE fighter, was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''<ref name="SWG" /> in [[W:c:swg:Game Update 20|Game Update 20]]<ref name="Update 20">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=69207&month=082011|text=Game Update 20: Galactic Civil War 2 &ndash; Space}}</ref> as one of various, randomly-generated "[[W:c:swg:Ace Pilot System|elite pilots]]" whom the player, as a Rebel character, can fight in a [[W:c:swg:Tier|Tier 7]] [[W:c:swg:Destroy Duty Missions|Duty Mission]]. When vanquished, a message indicates that the player successfully defeated Chiraneau. The player then receives a [[W:c:swg:Collection|collection]] icon for the feat.<ref name="SWG" />

===Deleted scenes===
[[File:MoffJerjerrodGreetsVader.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An unused version of the scene featuring Chiraneau was reused in the ''Special Edition'' of ''The Empire Strikes Back''.]]
According to [http://www.starwarz.com/tbone/the-crumbling-empire several images] found on [http://www.starwarz.com/tbone T-bone's Star Wars Universe] website, Chiraneau was meant to appear in at least two more scenes in ''Return of the Jedi'' not found in the film's final version. The first four images show Vader and a group of Imperial officers, Chiraneau included, heading toward the Death Star's docking bay to greet [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] upon his arrival.<ref name="T-bone">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarz.com/tbone/index.php?categoryid=11&p2_articleid=5|text=T-bone's Star Wars Universe - Return of the Jedi - Off To See The Emperor|author=T-bone|date=2003-06-03|work=T-bone's Star Wars Universe|archivedate=20071112111838}}</ref> A still from that deleted scene was used for the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Images-HT/starwars/DeathStarII-Dark/large/imperialcommand.gif "Imperial Command" card] for the ''Death Star II Limited'' set, though there was no confirmation that it depicted the same event in-universe.<ref name="Imperial Command" />

Because an alternate angle of the ''Return of the Jedi'' scene showing Vader's arrival on the second Death Star was reused for Vader's return to the ''Executor'' from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']], Mike Havord can be seen in the ''Special Edition'' version alongside other extras who portrayed Imperial officers in ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
